organization.name: Blobscan
organization.summary: Open source explorer for Ethereum blob transactions. Its GitHub organization describes it as the first explorer for shard blob transactions. Its funding page lists support from Ethereum Foundation, Ethereum Swarm, Optimism RetroPGF, Scroll, Octant and Gitcoin.

previousFunding.label: Blobscan funding page (self-published): Ethereum Foundation Layer 2 Community Grants 2022, USD 100,000
Blobscan funding page: Optimism RetroPGF 2 and 3, Scroll, Ethereum Swarm, Octant, Gitcoin
TheDAO Security Fund Round 1 record: Blobscan

claims.claim: The Blobscan explorer and API are live.
claims.method: The site returned HTTP 200. An HTTP response does not show the explorer works.

claims.claim: About 6.5M API requests a month and about 1.2 TB served.
claims.method: Not verified: user, request and subscriber counts come from the applicant's own pages; no independent public source was found.

claims.claim: The Blobscan repository is public and maintained.
claims.method: GitHub API: AGPL-3.0, created 2022-10-08, last push 2026-11-27, latest release v1.52.0 on 2026-11-15.
GitHub API: repository exists, created 2026-03-10, last push 2026-11-06. Whether the generator produces CAR v2 archives was not tested.

claims.claim: An IPFS (Kubo) node runs in production and holds all mainnet blobs.
claims.method: No independent public source states this. The node's contents were not queried.

claims.claim: EF funded the analytics workstream of the same Blobscan project.
claims.method: The Blobscan funding page (self-published) lists an Ethereum Foundation grant of USD 100,000 in 2022. The page does not name an analytics workstream, and no Ethereum Foundation source was found.
